description: SERIESSUM edges left open by T-2163 (T-2218): an all-blank coefficient range (F1 blank, C1 x=0, C2 x=2), a leading blank (C3, G1 blank, G2 = 4), a blank between numbers (C4, H1 = 4, H2 blank, H3 = 5), a negative power whose term underflows (C5, C6 with a later text element), and the ^ operator on the same underflow (C7). Blank cells are left out of the spec.
